note: The six actions. factIds are the history shown in the Historical Note when the action is used. Remedies are drawn by Consult Physician.

actions.name: Ship Goods
actions.short: Send cargo along a route for profit

actions.name: Open Trading Post
actions.short: Expand your network to a connected city

actions.name: Move Family
actions.short: Move family between cities, or flee to your estate

actions.name: Prepare Household
actions.short: Isolate and stockpile: better survival odds

actions.name: Consult Physician
actions.short: Medieval medicine: a slim chance, no cure

actions.name: Charity & Piety
actions.short: Support hospital or church for reputation

remedies.name: Bloodletting
remedies.text: The physician opens a vein to 'reduce the blood' and rebalance the humors.

remedies.name: Pills of aloe
remedies.text: Purging pills are meant to drive out corrupt humors.

remedies.name: Fires to purify the air
remedies.text: Fires are lit to burn away the 'corrupt air.'

remedies.name: Theriac
remedies.text: An expensive compound medicine is prescribed to 'comfort the heart.'

remedies.name: Figs and onions
remedies.text: A poultice of cooked figs and onions is laid on the swellings.

remedies.name: Sweet-smelling herbs
remedies.text: Flowers and spices are held to the nose against bad air.

remedies.name: The stars
remedies.text: The physician blames the conjunction of the planets in 1345.
